content.what_it_is: A one-page MATLAB-generated Encapsulated PostScript figure named solitary_nesting.eps. It compares solitary-wave surface-elevation profiles on nested Grid A and Grid B, marks the nesting boundary, labels horizontal position x and vertical elevation with a Symbol-font eta glyph encoded as (h), and identifies profiles at t=100 s, 200 s, 300 s, and 400 s. The plotted curves are stored as long PostScript MP/stroke coordinate sequences (lines 1-6617).
entities: MathWorks PostScript prolog, font, color, geometry, and path operators (lines 12-174)
Grid A plot panel and nesting-boundary annotation (lines 175-1999)
Grid B plot panel with four time-labelled profiles (lines 2000-6611)
calls: MathWorks dictionary and compact operator aliases define the generated PostScript drawing environment (lines 12-49)
FMS/FMSR select and re-encode fonts; csm sets page orientation and coordinate mapping (lines 50-62)
MP and related path operators emit the axes, annotations, and long relative-coordinate profile polylines (lines 73-6602)
eplot, epage, showpage, and the DSC trailer close the single-page EPS (lines 6608-6617)
